representation: 80-D B+U state; 13 physical successor predictions and 1 derived underheating quantity (Comfort_U)
acceptance_rule: Each evaluator is assessed independently under leave-one-natural-fragment-out validation. A formal 2 h channel requires complete fragment coverage and positive recursive RMSE skill versus matched persistence for both Tin_Mean and RTP_Total. The 13 physical-target metrics and derived underheating metric are reported as diagnostics and do not introduce a post hoc all-target-positive threshold.
target_policy_support_requirement: State-action support distances must be recorded during every formal policy rollout and reported separately by evaluator.
